title: Top 275 PDF: Words 251 to 275
subtitle: Sententious to Diaphanous (SSC CGL 2026 Digital Notes)

words.hindi: उपदेशात्मक / खुद को बड़ा दिखाने वाला
words.meaning: Given to moralizing in a pompous or affected manner.
words.example: The pompous speaker gave a self-important and sententious lecture.

words.meaning: Strong public criticism or verbal abuse.
words.example: The corrupt politician faced widespread public obloquy.

words.meaning: Deserving or causing public disgrace or shame.
words.example: The team suffered an ignominious defeat in the opening round.

words.hindi: किसी की कमज़ोर नकल करने वाला / अनुयायी
words.meaning: A less distinguished follower or imitator of someone, especially an artist or philosopher.
words.example: Many young writers started as epigones of great literary masters.

words.hindi: हर तरह का काम करने वाला सहायक
words.meaning: An employee who does all kinds of work.
words.example: He worked as the office factotum, managing everything from files to accounts.

words.meaning: Express vehement protest or public condemnation.
words.example: The leader denounced the corruption publicly.

words.meaning: The making of false and defamatory statements about someone in order to damage their reputation.
words.example: He fought bravely in court to clear his name of the wicked calumny.

words.meaning: Courtesy and considerate behavior toward others; mutual harmony.
words.example: International sports events promote comity among nations.

words.meaning: Treat or regard with contempt; despise.
words.example: One should never contemn the honest efforts of a beginner.

words.hindi: ज़ोर से और जोश में भाषण देना
words.meaning: Utter or deliver words or a speech in a rhetorical or impassioned way.
words.example: The speaker stood on the podium to declaim against injustice.

words.hindi: मुश्किल से पहचान लेना / दूर से देख लेना
words.meaning: Catch sight of; discern something distant or obscure.
words.example: She discerned a distant ship through the thick morning fog.

words.meaning: Brave and persistent; valiant.
words.example: The doughty soldiers defended the mountain post against all odds.

words.meaning: Dress up or decorate gaudily or showily.
words.example: The stage was bedizened with colorful lights and glittering banners.

words.meaning: Spiteful; bad-tempered and irritable.
words.example: His bilious remarks spoiled the mood of the entire meeting.

words.meaning: The protection, backing, or support of a particular person or organization.
words.example: The relief camp was organized under the aegis of the district administration.

words.hindi: किसी को देवता मानना / चरम उत्कर्ष
words.meaning: The elevation of someone to divine status; the highest point in the development of something.
words.example: Winning the gold medal was the apotheosis of her athletic career.

words.meaning: Complete and utter (typically used to emphasize something bad).
words.example: What he claimed about the exam postponement was arrant nonsense.

words.meaning: An act of attacking, plundering, or destroying.
words.example: The ancient walls protected the city from the depredations of invaders.

words.meaning: Made or used as a substitute, typically an inferior one, for something else.
words.example: During the shortage, people had to drink ersatz coffee made from grains.

words.hindi: बेकार / जिसका कोई काम या नतीजा न हो
words.meaning: Serving no practical purpose or result; futile.
words.example: Any further argument on a settled matter would be completely otiose.

words.meaning: The quality of having strong moral principles; honesty and decency.
words.example: A public servant must be a person of unquestionable financial probity.

words.meaning: Such as to provoke laughter; laughable and absurd.
words.example: The low offer they made for the land was positively risible.

words.meaning: Wise, or attempting to appear wise and judicious.
words.example: The wise elder settled the village dispute with sapient advice.

words.hindi: बहुत समझदार और सूझबूझ वाला / तीक्ष्ण बुद्धि
words.meaning: Shrewd, sharp, or discerning.
words.example: An argute student quickly spots the trick in a reasoning question.

words.hindi: पारदर्शी / जिससे हल्की रोशनी आर-पार जाए
words.meaning: Light, delicate, and translucent (especially of fabric).
words.example: Sunlight passed softly through the diaphanous curtain.
